notes:
New: Company Copy (Tally → Tally):

Move one company's data from this Tally into another — a different company, a fresh install, another machine.

• Export: pick a source company and a date range, and it pulls Groups, Ledgers, Voucher Types and every Voucher for that period into one backup file, named after the client.
• Import: switch Tally to the target company, refresh the connection, load the backup file, and import — only masters missing in the target are created, every voucher is recreated fresh. A summary shows exactly what was created and flags anything that failed.

Note: Cost Centre categories aren't auto-recreated (a company-wide Tally setting this gateway can't flip remotely) — check that manually if the company uses them.
